description: Look up a darts glossary term (bust, oche, checkout, madhouse, Shanghai, ...) and get its sourced plain-text definition, origin when a source states one, source links and the dolfdarts.com glossary URL with the term's #anchor. Optional locale (any of the 12 released language codes, default en). An unknown term returns found:false with up to 5 closest terms, not an error.

locale.description: Language of the glossary to search and answer in (default 'en'). The term is matched against that locale's own wording.

term.description: Darts term to define, e.g. 'bust', 'oche', 'madhouse', 'Shanghai'. Case and diacritics are ignored; the term name and its URL slug are matched.

name: define_term
title: Define a darts term
